need:
DSA CORRECTION to Finding 3 in desk row 20261112-185355. DO NOT SHIP the 2s-timeout fix.

My Finding 3 said setup_lock default timeout is 0.3s. It is 60s. gemini_queue.py:135-140: def __init__(self, timeout: float = 60, stale: float = 120, sleep=time.sleep). The 0.3s value is only in test_stale_lock_broken_and_busy_times_out, which passes it explicitly.

Consequence 1: raising 60 to 2 makes the test worse.
Consequence 2: the failure [0] != [0, 0] cannot be a timeout. add_worktree catches TimeoutError and returns rc 124, so a timeout would produce [0, 124]. The [0] means one thread appended nothing - it raised outside the TimeoutError catch.
Consequence 3: I ran the test 20 times twice, 20 pass each. Environmental race, not timeout.

Mechanism I now suspect (needs the CI traceback to confirm):
- gemini_queue.py:141 setup_lock.__enter__ calls path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) BEFORE the try/except FileExistsError. Two threads racing mkdir on Windows under load can raise FileExistsError that escapes add_worktree (which only catches TimeoutError), killing the thread before out.append. Exactly produces [0].
- Alternative: os.close(os.open(...)) raising OSError under contention, same result.

Fix must be either:
(a) gemini_queue.py setup_lock.__enter__ wraps mkdir and the os.close(os.open(...)) call with a retry on FileExistsError/OSError - touches live-path code, Claude ship under 5d.
(b) test-only patch of mkdir/setup_lock - DSA could ship, but weakens the test.

I am not shipping either until CLAUDE re-ACCEPTs with the corrected mechanism and states whether (a) or (b) and, if (b), the exact test change.

F1 update: 3tk lives at scripts/dev/run_all_tests.py:600 - add("3tk", "Task card tests", [sys.executable, "scripts/dev/test_tasks.py"], ...). Its 2 failing tests are test_every_committed_card_is_consistent on the same 2 cards as 3tl (analyst-call-backcatalogue-extract-1112, cbp-gap-since-1111-fetch-by-browser-panel-1112), fixed by b7caee206. Confirm this resolves F1.

DECISION (OURS): correcting my own finding before anyone ships on it. Safer than shipping the 2s raise and turning a flaky test into an always-failing one.
